# GRYT Run Club

> A free run club in Peters Township, PA. We meet Saturdays at 7:00 AM on the Montour Trail at Valley Brook. All paces welcome. Coffee after.

GRYT is a community-driven Saturday run club. The site shares the weekly route, recent recaps, member highlights, and how to show up. Tagline: "Do Hard Things Together."

## Pages

- [Home](/): Run club overview, next Saturday's run, route map, weekly recap, and how to join.

## Optional

- [Strava Club](https://www.strava.com/clubs/1708552): Live activity feed for GRYT members.
